dependency_boundaries: Pure grouping, ranking, terminology and cache-port imports are allowlisted by AST test.
adapter_contracts: Cached and uncached search return the same results using isolated SQLite; tool consumers share the injected cache.
limits: Theme labels are suggestions, not authoritative categories.
Public definitions require supported public evidence.
Single-user localhost deployment; no authentication or tenant ownership enforcement.
No penetration test or container OS scan.
